**Russian Federation: scale and change.** Across 2000–2025, the extract records 657,711 applications. The largest annual volume was 274,716 in 2014; 2025 recorded 8,507. Applications in 2025 were 5.1% higher than in 2019 (8,091). In 2025, 8,918 recorded decisions equated to 105 per 100 applications, so recorded output exceeded incoming volume. Applications in 2025 were 21% higher than in 2024 (7,018). Applications exceeded recorded decisions in 2 of 5 comparable years during 2021-2025. The leading recorded origins that year were Ukraine (3,355), Syrian Arab Rep. (3,320), Afghanistan (286).

In 2025, the substantive protection rate was 100%, across 7,889 grants and refusals; closures accounted for 12% of all recorded decisions. That protection rate was 0.0 percentage points higher than in 2024 (100%).
